description: For every structure embedding \(f:M\to N\) between nonempty models of the strict dense-order theory, there is an elementary embedding \(e:M\to N\) for the same language whose underlying map is \(f\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.strictDlo_embedding_isElementary.{u, v} {M : Type u}
  {N : Type v} [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage.Structure M]
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage.Structure N]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.strictDloTheory]
  [N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.strictDloTheory] [Nonempty M] [Nonempty N]
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage.Embedding M N) : ∃ e, ⇑e = ⇑f
